title: arrhenatherum elatius f. precatorium
intro: Arrhenatherum elatius f. precatorium, commonly known as 'False Oat-grass', is a flowering plant species in the grass family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing several health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antispasmodic effects, which help in soothing digestive issues, reducing pain and inflammation. The therapeutic actions of False Oat-grass include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce anxiety and stress, and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties and are responsible for its therapeutic actions.
